result.summary: Found 1 minor visual/accessibility issue: promotional banner text has poor contrast against its light background.

issues.description: The white headline and promotional details in the pale green delivery banner are difficult to read because they have insufficient contrast with the background, especially over the lighter decorative shape on the right.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color, darken the banner background, or add a stronger translucent overlay behind the text to meet accessible contrast requirements.
